weak_verb_supported.why_it_matters: Recruiters scan for ownership and leadership. 'Supported' signals junior execution, not impact.

templates.generic: Contributed to [X] transactions by [specific action], resulting in [outcome]

weak_verb_supported.example_before: Supported due diligence on various deals
weak_verb_supported.example_after: Led financial due diligence on 4 acquisitions ($50-200M EV), identifying $3M in working capital adjustments that informed final pricing

weak_verb_assisted.issue: Suggests you were a helper, not an owner
weak_verb_assisted.why_it_matters: Even if you weren't the lead, frame your specific contribution with an active verb.

templates.primary: Executed [specific task] as part of [larger project], delivering [outcome]
templates.with_numbers: Managed [specific aspect] for [X] deals/projects, resulting in [measurable impact]

weak_verb_assisted.example_before: Assisted the team with financial modeling
weak_verb_assisted.example_after: Built 15+ financial models including DCF and LBO analyses for transactions ranging from $50M-$500M

weak_verb_participated.trigger: Participated in|Was involved in|Took part in
weak_verb_participated.why_it_matters: Define your specific role and ownership within the broader effort.

templates.primary: Served as [specific role] on [project], responsible for [deliverables]

weak_verb_participated.example_after: Served as lead analyst on 3 M&A transactions ($100-300M), managing financial modeling and due diligence workstreams

weak_verb_responsible.why_it_matters: Every CV says what people were 'responsible for.' Stand out by showing what you achieved.
weak_verb_responsible.example_after: Developed 50+ client presentations that supported $2B+ in closed transactions, receiving commendation from senior partners

weak_verb_worked_on.issue: Vague activity with no clear ownership or outcome
weak_verb_worked_on.why_it_matters: This phrase tells recruiters nothing about your role, impact, or skills used.
weak_verb_worked_on.example_after: Delivered 8 strategic assessments for Fortune 500 clients, with recommendations adopted by 6 C-suite teams

weak_verb_handled.issue: Suggests reactive work rather than proactive contribution
weak_verb_handled.why_it_matters: Frame yourself as a problem solver, not a task processor.

templates.initiative: Identified and resolved [issue/challenge], preventing [negative outcome] / saving [X]

weak_verb_handled.example_after: Managed relationships with 15 institutional LPs representing $500M in commitments, achieving 95% re-up rate

no_quantification.issue: Vague scope - recruiters can't assess impact
no_quantification.why_it_matters: Quantified bullets are 40% more likely to catch a recruiter's attention. Numbers = credibility.

templates.deal_focused: [Action verb] [X] deals worth $[X]M total enterprise value
templates.deliverable_focused: Built [X] models / Prepared [X] presentations / Conducted [X] interviews
templates.time_focused: Delivered [outcome] within [X] weeks, [X]% ahead of schedule

no_quantification.example_before: Prepared financial models for several transactions
no_quantification.example_after: Built 8 integrated LBO models for healthcare transactions ($75-250M EV), supporting 3 successful acquisitions

missing_outcome.why_it_matters: Activities show what you did. Outcomes show why it mattered. Recruiters care about impact.

templates.deal_outcome: [Activity], resulting in successful close at [X]x EBITDA / $[X]M valuation
templates.process_outcome: [Activity], reducing turnaround time by [X]% / improving accuracy by [X]%
templates.client_outcome: [Activity], securing [X] new mandates / expanding relationship to [X] services

missing_outcome.example_before: Conducted market research and competitive analysis
missing_outcome.example_after: Conducted market research and competitive analysis that identified 3 acquisition targets, one of which became a $150M platform investment

vague_quantity.why_it_matters: 'Several deals' could mean 2 or 20. Specificity shows you tracked your work and take pride in it.
vague_quantity.example_before: Worked on various deals across multiple sectors
vague_quantity.example_after: Executed 12 transactions across 4 sectors (healthcare, consumer, industrials, tech)

missing_sector.why_it_matters: Sector experience is often a key filter. Make it easy for recruiters to see your relevant exposure.
missing_sector.example_after: Led due diligence on 5 healthcare services acquisitions (dental, urgent care, behavioral health)

missing_deal_size.why_it_matters: A $10M deal is very different from a $1B deal. Size indicates the complexity you've handled.
missing_deal_size.example_before: Executed multiple acquisitions for private equity clients
missing_deal_size.example_after: Executed 6 acquisitions ($50-300M EV) for private equity clients including [Fund Names]

generic_skills.issue: Generic skills waste valuable bullet space
generic_skills.why_it_matters: Everyone claims these traits. Show them through specific examples instead.

templates.show_communication: Replace with: Presented to [audience] resulting in [outcome]
templates.show_teamwork: Replace with: Collaborated with [X] teams across [functions] to deliver [result]
templates.show_attention: Replace with: Identified [error/opportunity] that saved $[X] / prevented [issue]

generic_skills.example_before: Strong communication skills and attention to detail
generic_skills.example_after: Presented investment recommendations to IC, with 85% approval rate on proposed transactions

chronological_confusion.issue: Unclear timeline confuses recruiters and ATS
chronological_confusion.why_it_matters: Recruiters scan dates to understand your trajectory. Inconsistency suggests carelessness.
chronological_confusion.example_after: Jan 2022 - Present, Jan 2020 - Dec 2021, Jun 2018 - Dec 2019

buzzword_overload.issue: Buzzwords without substance suggest filler content
buzzword_overload.why_it_matters: Overused buzzwords signal that you lack specifics. Replace with concrete examples.

templates.replace_synergies: Identified $[X]M in cost reduction opportunities through [specific actions]

buzzword_overload.example_before: Leveraged best-in-class processes to drive synergies
buzzword_overload.example_after: Implemented procurement consolidation across 3 portfolio companies, achieving $2.5M in annual cost savings

passive_voice.issue: Passive voice suggests you were directed rather than initiating
passive_voice.why_it_matters: Active voice demonstrates ownership and initiative - qualities recruiters value.

templates.to_active: Replace 'Was given responsibility for X' with 'Assumed/Led/Managed X'
templates.show_initiative: Volunteered to [take on challenge], resulting in [outcome]

passive_voice.example_before: Was assigned to lead the due diligence workstream
passive_voice.example_after: Led due diligence workstream for $150M acquisition, coordinating 5 third-party advisors

missing_company_context.trigger: company size/type not mentioned for lesser-known firms
missing_company_context.issue: Recruiters may not recognize your employer
missing_company_context.why_it_matters: Context helps recruiters understand the scale and prestige of your experience.
missing_company_context.example_before: Private Equity Associate at XYZ Partners
missing_company_context.example_after: Private Equity Associate at XYZ Partners, a $2B AUM middle-market fund focused on healthcare services

missing_tools_systems.issue: Missing tool/system names that ATS may search for
missing_tools_systems.why_it_matters: Many companies use ATS keyword filters. Mentioning tools increases your match rate.

templates.add_data_sources: Leveraging [data sources: Bloomberg, Capital IQ, etc.] to [outcome]

missing_tools_systems.example_before: Conducted company research and prepared valuations
missing_tools_systems.example_after: Conducted company research using Capital IQ and PitchBook, building DCF and LBO models in Excel to support investment decisions

missing_team_leadership.issue: Team size indicates scope of responsibility
missing_team_leadership.why_it_matters: Managing 2 people vs 20 people are very different experiences. Be specific.

templates.add_dotted_line: Provided mentorship to [X] junior analysts, with [X] promoted within [timeframe]

missing_team_leadership.example_before: Led a team on various projects
missing_team_leadership.example_after: Led team of 4 analysts and associates on 6 live transactions, with 2 analysts receiving early promotion

weak_action_verbs.why_it_matters: Strong action verbs immediately convey competence and impact.
weak_action_verbs.example_after: Developed and delivered executive presentations to C-suite leadership across 5 portfolio companies

no_progression_shown.why_it_matters: Recruiters look for growth trajectory. Show promotions, expanded scope, or new responsibilities.

templates.show_promotion: Promoted from [previous role] to [current role] within [X months/years]
templates.show_scope_expansion: Expanded responsibilities to include [new areas] following [achievement]

no_progression_shown.example_after: Investment Analyst, promoted to Senior Analyst after 18 months (2019-2022)

jargon_without_context.trigger: technical acronyms without explanation for non-PE audience
jargon_without_context.issue: Industry jargon may not translate across sectors
jargon_without_context.why_it_matters: While PE-specific roles understand jargon, some screeners may not. Balance is key.

templates.define_first_use: First use: spell out, subsequent uses: acronym only

jargon_without_context.example_before: Prepared IC materials and CIM for LBO opportunities
jargon_without_context.example_after: Prepared Investment Committee materials and Confidential Information Memoranda for leveraged buyout opportunities

missing_stakeholder_interaction.why_it_matters: Presenting to Partners vs. Analysts indicates different levels of exposure and trust.
missing_stakeholder_interaction.example_after: Prepared investment memoranda presented to Investment Committee, supporting $400M in approved investments

missing_frequency_volume.why_it_matters: Daily modeling is different from quarterly modeling. Show the intensity of your experience.
missing_frequency_volume.example_after: Updated 15 portfolio company financial models monthly, tracking KPIs and providing quarterly board reporting

missing_competitive_context.issue: Achievements gain power in relative terms
missing_competitive_context.why_it_matters: Top 10% performer is more impressive than 'performed well.'
missing_competitive_context.example_after: Exceeded investment targets by 35%, ranking in top quartile among 12-person analyst class

missing_problem_context.why_it_matters: The 'before' state makes the 'after' state more compelling.
missing_problem_context.example_after: Identified 2-week lag in portfolio reporting; implemented automated dashboard, reducing reporting cycle to 3 days

missing_scope_complexity.why_it_matters: Managing a simple project vs. a complex multi-stakeholder initiative are different skill levels.

templates.add_constraints: Delivered [outcome] despite [constraint: tight timeline/limited resources/competing priorities]

missing_scope_complexity.example_after: Managed 90-day integration involving 5 workstreams and 12 cross-functional teams, achieving Day 1 readiness on schedule

missing_initiative.issue: Only showing assigned work suggests limited initiative
missing_initiative.why_it_matters: Self-initiated projects demonstrate drive and ability to identify opportunities.

templates.show_initiative: Identified opportunity to [improve/create] and [took action] resulting in [outcome]

missing_initiative.example_after: Developed reusable LBO model template adopted firm-wide, reducing new deal setup time by 50%

education_lacking_context.why_it_matters: Honors, relevant coursework, and activities make education section work harder.
education_lacking_context.example_after: BS Finance, State University, Magna Cum Laude | Investment Club President | Managed $50K student fund

internship_undersold.issue: Internships often undersold despite real contributions
internship_undersold.why_it_matters: Even as an intern, you likely had measurable impact. Capture it.

templates.show_value: Selected from [X] candidates for full-time return offer based on [contribution]

internship_undersold.example_after: Summer Analyst, Investment Bank | Built merger model for $2B transaction | Received full-time return offer, extended to 1 of 3 interns

certification_without_status.issue: Unclear if credential is completed or in progress
certification_without_status.why_it_matters: CFA Charterholder vs CFA Level 1 Candidate are very different. Be clear.
certification_without_status.example_after: CFA Level II Candidate (June 2025 exam) | CFA Level I passed December 2024

missing_client_type.trigger: client work mentioned without client description
missing_client_type.issue: Client type indicates sophistication of experience
missing_client_type.why_it_matters: Working with Fortune 500 vs small businesses demonstrates different skill levels.

templates.add_client_count: Served [X] [client type] clients with combined [metric: revenue/AUM/employees]

missing_client_type.example_before: Provided financial advisory services to clients
missing_client_type.example_after: Provided M&A advisory to 8 PE-backed portfolio companies ($50-500M revenue), supporting exit planning and add-on acquisitions

missing_geographic_scope.issue: Geographic scope indicates complexity and exposure
missing_geographic_scope.why_it_matters: Cross-border experience is increasingly valuable. Highlight international exposure.

templates.add_cross_border: Managed cross-border [transaction/project] between [Region A] and [Region B]

missing_geographic_scope.example_after: Executed 5 cross-border M&A transactions involving targets in UK, Germany, and Nordics
